description: Run the Chapter 7 means test: compare income with your state median and derive the disposable-income thresholds.
Score each debt by after-tax cost, asset yield and spread to separate wealth-building debt from wealth-draining debt.
Compare current balances with a consolidation loan and see net interest saved after the origination fee.
Chart a debt payoff timeline with milestone dates, interest paid and the effect of extra monthly payments.
Decide how much cash buffer to hold before attacking debt by comparing surplus savings with one month of essentials.
